_provenance.authority: Live authenticated Cotality API on Trestle. This artifact is GENERATED — never hand-edit it. It is the single field and vocabulary authority; no snapshot, CSV or transcribed table may be consulted.
_provenance.scoping: Vocabulary is scoped to the authorized subscription by exact-token match within Lookup.SystemReferences. The system code is DISCOVERED at build time from the provider itself (Property.OriginatingSystemName) and is deliberately NOT recorded here: a distribution-system name is not Mallan vocabulary. Unscoped values are the union across ~118 MLS systems and are NOT ours.
_provenance.selectability: selectableFields comes from $metadata EntityType declarations and is authoritative for $select. The Field endpoint returns additional non-selectable platform fields which are recorded as fieldMetadata only and MUST NOT be placed in a $select.
